summary: acer nitro 16 gaming system has moderate to high thermal profile, with temperatures reaching up to 80°C during intense gaming sessions. The system also exhibits some color shifting or ghosting under certain conditions.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and BSOD errors due to driver issues and hardware conflicts.
suggested_solution: Regularly monitor system temperatures, keep drivers and BIOS up-to-date, use a high-quality power supply, and consider using a battery saver or power management software.
